title: Validate member profile changes while allowing duplicate display aliases
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Use existing deterministic engine RNG only where the contract permits. Never turn a trusted verifier input into a claim of cryptographic verification. Unspecified rules remain explicit named decision-required results; no worker invents policies. Preserve existing T01–T10 API/tests. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests, then node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full. Return a handoff with paths, API, actual checks, benchmark receipt references and limitations. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement decodeLobbyProfilePatch exactly as frozen in section B084 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Exact own data keys alias/avatarKey/expectedRevision. Alias must already be trimmed,1–24 Unicode scalar values and contain no controls; duplicates across players remain legal. avatarKey must belong to the supplied approved registry. Validate without getters; no subject/player identity or role edits are accepted.
acceptance: Valid Unicode aliases and registry avatars decode to detached values, independent of any other player alias.
Empty/overlong/control aliases, unknown avatars and unsafe revisions reject.
Forged actor/host/role fields, symbols/accessors/prototype objects and empty/duplicate avatar registry entries fail safely.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
